text.en:
The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Estancia is hereby
expanded and particularly described as follows:
"Beginning at point marked I on the plan, thence to point 2
at a distance of 200.00m with bearing S 50°00' W, thence to point 3
at a distance of 1,240.00m with bearing S 53°00' E, thence to point 4
at a distance of 395.00m with bearing N 37°43' E, thence to point 5
at a distance of 1,200.00m with bearing N 53°00' W, thence to point
I, the point of beginning at a distance of 200.00m with bearing S
37°00' W, all in all comprising a total area of 477,235.95 sq. m.
more or less."

The Estancia Port Zone, as expanded, is hereby placed under the
administrative jurisdiction
of the Philippine Ports Authority, which shall,
consistent with the regional industrial plans of the Government, implement a
program for the proper zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port.

All other orders, proclamations and issuances or portions thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
